info.fullName: Waste Awareness Skills Training & Education — Uzbekistan
info.fullNameUz: Chiqindilarni boshqarish bo'yicha xabardorlik, ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirish va ta'lim — O'zbekiston
info.grantingAuthority: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) — A.4 International Partnerships in Higher Education
info.abstract: The project aims to develop and strengthen smart waste management competencies among university students in Uzbekistan through a comprehensive program of online and offline courses, workshops, and practical activities. By integrating digital tools, data analytics, and innovative technologies, students will learn how to design, implement, and optimize sustainable waste management solutions in both urban and rural settings. The project will encourage student-led innovation and entrepreneurship by supporting the creation of start-ups focused on circular economy practices, smart recycling systems, and eco-friendly technology solutions.
info.abstract2: Through collaboration with two European Union universities, the project will bring international expertise and best practices to Uzbekistan, enhancing the quality of higher education in environmental technology and IT applications. It will foster intercultural exchange, joint curriculum development, and capacity building for faculty and students alike. By the end of the project, students will not only acquire theoretical knowledge but also practical skills, digital competencies, and entrepreneurial experience, empowering them to contribute actively to sustainable development and smart environmental management in Uzbekistan.
info.abstract3: This initiative aligns with national priorities for environmental sustainability, innovation, and higher education modernization, positioning participating universities as leaders in promoting technological solutions for waste management.
info.abstractUz: Loyiha O'zbekiston oliy ta'lim muassasalari talabalarida zamonaviy onlayn va oflayn kurslar, amaliy mashg'ulotlar va seminarlar orqali aqlli chiqindilarni boshqarish ko'nikmalarini rivojlantirish va kuchaytirishga qaratilgan. Raqamli vositalar, ma'lumotlar tahlili va innovatsion texnologiyalarni integratsiyalash orqali talabalar shahar va qishloq sharoitida barqaror chiqindi boshqaruvi tizimlarini loyihalash, joriy etish va optimallashtirishni o'rganadilar. Loyiha aylanma iqtisodiyot (circular economy), aqlli qayta ishlash tizimlari va ekologik texnologiyalar bo'yicha startaplar yaratishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

news.title: Official Launch of the Erasmus+ Project WASTE-UZ (101322962)
news.author: AKHU Project Office
news.summary: The European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) has officially launched the WASTE-UZ project coordinated by Al-Khwarizmi University.
news.summaryUz: Yevropa Ta'lim va Madaniyat Ijroiya Agentligi (EACEA) Al-Xorazmiy universiteti koordinatsiyasidagi WASTE-UZ loyihasini rasman ishga tushirdi.
news.content: Al-Khwarizmi University in Urgench, in collaboration with Universidad de Vigo (Spain), Gaziantep University (Türkiye), Bukhara State University, Green University, and Fergana State Technical University, is proud to announce the commencement of the WASTE-UZ initiative. Co-funded by the Erasmus+ Programme the 36-month initiative targets smart waste management training, circular economy education, and practical technological incubation.

news.title: Upcoming Consortium Kick-off Meeting & Steering Committee Session
news.titleUz: Hamkorlar konsorsiumining dastlabki yig'ilishi va Boshqaruv qo'mitasi sessiyasi
news.author: Coordination Secretariat
news.summary: Representatives of all 6 partner institutions will convene to finalize the operational roadmap for Work Packages 1 and 2.
news.summaryUz: Barcha 6 ta hamkor oliy ta'lim muassasalari vakillari 1 va 2-ish paketlari bo'yicha operatsion yo'l xaritasini tasdiqlash uchun yig'iladilar.
news.content: The hybrid kick-off meeting will bring together institutional leaders from Urgench, Vigo, Gaziantep, Bukhara, Tashkent, and Fergana. Agenda items include student survey deployment, ethical approvals, financial guidelines, and the establishment of the Green Innovation Hubs.
